contracts.order: Actual Colossal Warmech/reaction -> one Kelas Warmech spin -> atomic selected unit/weapon grant and pending stat-source registration -> actual result/grant reaction -> Backstory.
contracts.probability: Exactly four accepted classes at baseWeight1/25% each before authorized eligibility/distribution policies; no extra model/loadout/count/success spin.
contracts.reward: Selected recipe gives exactly one external mech counted as one weapon and two numeric main-stat points: Brawler Strength+2; Fortress Durability+2; Blitz Speed+2; Artillery Intelligence+2. Fight+2 is superseded for Artillery. Package is exclusive; no other class reward or universal all-stat+2.
contracts.recipeAuthority: Execute only the selected rewardProfiles entry, its one weaponGrant and statModifiers once. Loadout/weapon/context definitions are metadata for the same unit, not another reward instruction.
contracts.ownership: Mech is one separate source-owned unit linked to one weapon instance. Included fists/cannon/railgun/missiles/blade/armor/booster are loadout parts; do not create additional owned weapons or armor pieces. Preserve earlier inventory and normal main acquisition/None retention; normal main Weapon remains scheduled.
contracts.character: Owner identity/body/race history stays sourced by actual Race results. This equipment grant dispatches no Machine/Raksasa/Rider/Anime event, pilot/crew reward, extra Archetype or extra owner Size spin. Unit dimensions/control/fit use explicit equipment profiles, never a guessed Human body reference or owner enlargement.
contracts.stats: Register the selected +2 numeric modifier once under its source ledger at class commit. Calculate only in final bonus phase from retained immutable raw stat and distinct active modifiers/the signed, unbounded score policys; raw Resilient/Lucky/Pawn evidence stays unchanged.
contracts.mastery: Selected active unit uses one ordinary per-weapon raw mastery at the normal stage, with final matching source bonuses and compatible effective-Master5+ Enchant. No new mastery guarantee/boost, extra component mastery or Power grant. Preserve central inventory/acquisition guards; missing profiles require configuration.
contracts.ledger: Freeze class pool/odds, rule/version/result, selected recipe and unit/weapon definition. Atomic source key runId/sourceArchetypeInvocationId/sourceClassSpinId/eventProfileId; link one unitInstanceId to one weaponInstanceId and distinct modifier source. Replay/media retries restore existing transaction and reaction without redraw, duplicate weapon or compound bonus.
contracts.context: Stack actual class/loadout/owned unit and pending selected stat bonus with provenance. Future Backstory/Size/stat/mastery results remain unknown. No funny-result tag or Shrek hook inferred from names/fixed grants.
contracts.return: Complete selected transaction and reaction before restoring Backstory; preserve accepted gate, source race exclusions and main sequence.
contracts.runtime: Core accepted; explicit unit capability/dimensions/control/body-role compatibility and persistence executor remain configuration. Whole Archetype roster remains inactive.
